text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Wednesday:

- Swiss citizens have become more open toward international organisations like the U.N., Nato, peace troops and the European Union, according to a Federal Institute of Technology report. - Swiss President Arnold Koller received some 32 foreign Swiss kids in Berne on Tuesday. The children are spending their holidays in a Swiss camp.
- The merger of Swiss insurer Winterthur and Credit Suisse may lead to a new strategic orientation in the Swiss banking and insurance market, insiders say.
- A tax reform based on ecologic view points may have a positive effect on the Swiss labour market, a university study funded by the Swiss government wrote.
- Ending a year-long relationship with Lufthansa, Finnish airline Finnair now plans to deepen cooperation with Swissair.

- Swiss labour unions and the Swiss Social Democrats started yesterday their campaign against a federal referendum to cut umemployment insurance spending. President of the Social Democrats Ursual Koch called the referendum socially inconsiderate, financially unnecessary and based on the wrong facts.
